description: This file defines server-side logic for the SignUpPage in an online exam system. It handles user registration, including saving user details and uploaded images to a database, and provides navigation to the login page.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: A partial class for the sign-up web page, handling user registration logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for initial page load; currently does nothing.

methods.name: loginB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for login button click; transfers user to the login page.

methods.name: signUpB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for sign-up button click; handles user registration, including password verification, image upload, and database insertion.
